transcript_tail.text: Act as a manager and trigger separate sessions, uh, call the managers

Switching to manager mode. The /manage skill says: plan first, get boss OK, then dispatch.

Let me set up the manager state (my own cse_id) and check the project board mapping before proposing the worker split.

Both repos are real GitHub repos. `dstrader` lives on Trading & Fund board (#1); `jdtogni-site` has no project board.

**Proposed plan:** Single worker for the first wave (the only one with content gates), in `~/dev/dstrader`:

| Worker | Repo | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **DEMO** | `~/dev/dstrader` | Draft `demos/investment-strategy.demo.yaml` (10-scene transcript per the plan you signed off) + build `demos/investment-strategy-explainer.html` scaffold matching the rebalancing-explainer style. Report transcript back to me before any rendering. |

**Why one worker first, not two:** the site-wiring work (adding the section to `dstrader.html`) is trivial and blocked on the rendered mp4 anyway — there's no real parallelism to win by spawning it now. We dispatch the SITE worker as Wave 2 once the transcript is approved + the demo is rendered. Saves running an idle worker.

Two confirmations before I dispatch:

expected.rec_session: File ticket on Trading & Fund #1 first (Recommended), Yes — include a `say`-voice test render in the report
